profile.title: Architectural Designer & Spatial Researcher
profile.tagline: Exploring the continuum between tectonic structure, natural light, and human habitation.

projects.title: Casa Verdant
projects.subtitle: Hillside Biophilic Residence
projects.summary: Nestled into the contours of the mountain, Casa Verdant explores the interplay of monolithic exposed concrete and extensive glazed facades, dissolving the boundaries between domestic shelter and forest canopy.

details.concept: The design adopts a stepped volume strategy that adheres strictly to the existing natural topography, minimizing cut-and-fill operations. Natural ventilation courtyards act as passive cooling chimneys.
details.materials: Board-formed architectural concrete, reclaimed teak louvers, low-E triple glazing, local volcanic stone.

items.title: Pavilion of Solitude
items.summary: A temporary meditation pavilion constructed with sustainable laminated timber, casting shifting shadows with coastal sunlight.

items.title: Linear Green Spine
items.summary: Revitalizing redundant railway corridors into a pedestrian-first biophilic urban greenway.

items.title: Atelier Monolith
items.summary: Adaptive reuse of a 1970s print workshop into a minimalist ceramic artist studio and exhibition gallery.

projects.title: Harbor Archive & Cultural Hub
projects.subtitle: Civic Memory & Marine Research Facility
projects.summary: Conceived as an extension of the tidal maritime landscape, the building acts as a public terrace framing harbor vistas while housing archives of regional maritime heritage and marine biodiversity research labs.

details.concept: A dual-cantilever structure mimics the heavy cranes of the historic dockyards, lifting exhibition galleries above ground level to create a 24-hour open civic plaza beneath.
details.materials: Weathering steel panels, seawater-resistant marine aluminum, translucent structural U-glass.

items.title: Parametric Bamboo Canopy
items.summary: Computational weave morphology combining traditional Taiwanese moso bamboo bending with CNC-milled steel joint nodes.

items.title: Courtyard Residence VII
items.summary: Three micro-courtyards orchestrating microclimatic thermal drafts and serene garden views from every room.

items.title: Echo Tea Pavilion
items.summary: A cliffside tearoom cantilevered over misty valleys, framing seasonal fog and cypress forestry.

projects.title: The Fold: Community Library
projects.subtitle: Topographical Learning Commons
projects.summary: The green roof folds upward from the rice paddies, forming an accessible landscaped park above and continuous, gently ramping reading terraces beneath.

details.concept: Subverting the monumentalism of traditional civic libraries into a humble, topography-integrated shelter that harmonizes with Yilan's rainy climate.
details.materials: Locally quarried schist stone, green sedum roof, laminated spruce glue-lam arches.
